name: Tunemarchy
author: atlastimed
description: Spotify in the Omarchy bar: now playing, seek, shuffle, repeat and volume over MPRIS, plus optional liked songs, up-next queue and Connect devices.

barWidget.description: What Spotify is playing, with a dropdown for seek, transport, volume, likes, the queue and Connect devices.

schema.label: Maximum label width (px)
schema.description: Longer titles are shortened with an ellipsis. 0 shows only the icon.

schema.label: When Spotify is closed
schema.description: icon: keep a dimmed icon that opens Spotify. hide: remove the widget until Spotify starts.

schema.label: Scrolling on the widget
schema.description: volume changes Spotify's volume; skip goes to the previous or next song.

schema.label: Spotify app Client ID (optional)
schema.description: Turns on likes, the queue and Connect devices. Create an app at developer.spotify.com/dashboard with redirect URI http://127.0.0.1:43117/callback, then paste its Client ID here. No client secret is needed.
